001package io.jstach.rainbowgum;
002
003/**
004 * Identifies which logging facade a logger name passed to
005 * {@link LogConfig.LoggerRegistry#registerLoggerName(LoggerAPI, String)} came through.
006 *
007 * @apiNote currently informational only: {@link LogConfig.LoggerRegistry} does not yet do
008 * anything different based on which {@link LoggerAPI} a name was registered with.
009 */
010public sealed interface LoggerAPI permits LoggerAPI.Standard {
011
012        /**
013         * The logging facades RainbowGum ships an implementation for.
014         */
015        enum Standard implements LoggerAPI {
016
017                /**
018                 * {@code rainbowgum-slf4j}.
019                 */
020                SLF4J,
021                /**
022                 * {@code rainbowgum-systemlogger} ({@link java.lang.System.Logger}).
023                 */
024                SYSTEM_LOGGER,
025                /**
026                 * {@code rainbowgum-log4j2} (Log4j2's own API, not an SLF4J binding).
027                 */
028                LOG4J2,
029                /**
030                 * {@code rainbowgum-jul-logmanager} ({@code java.util.logging}).
031                 */
032                JUL,
033                /**
034                 * {@code rainbowgum-jboss-logging}.
035                 */
036                JBOSS_LOGGING,
037                /**
038                 * {@code rainbowgum-avaje-config} ({@code io.avaje.applog.AppLog}).
039                 */
040                AVAJE_APPLOG,
041                /**
042                 * A facade not represented by another constant of this enum.
043                 */
044                UNSUPPORTED;
045
046        }
047
048}
